reference_answer: The analysis distinguishes naturally occurring variation from measurement error. Specifically, the digital copy preserves some visual details of the original. These concrete observations clarify the operational scope of the method without overstating its generality.

explanation_zh:

地道学术写作从不说 *extremely great / solves all problems*，而是用具体操作与边界说话：
- 第 1 句用“naturally”（The analysis distinguishes naturally occurring variation from measurement error.）给出具体研究事实或操作定义；
- 第 2 句用“original”（The digital copy preserves some visual details of the original.）补充具体测量、分布或样本条件；
